summary: Compromise of d.yilmaz@aegean.edu via likely phishing at aegean-edu.co followed by MFA fatigue from 185.220.101.7. Attacker achieved impossible travel, bulk SIS access (38 events/60 min), and created an inbox forwarding rule to an external Gmail. Forty-seven sign-ins originated from BulwarkHost NL. Risk Gate directs containment at confidence 0.94.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing mail from aegean-edu.co delivered and clicked (F4, F8), MFA fatigue with 7 denials then 1 approval from 185.220.101.7 (F3), followed by bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min) from the same IP (F1), persistence via API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F5), and additional suspicious sign-ins from BulwarkHost NL ASN with impossible travel (F6, F2). The rejected 193.140.10.44 spray claim is explained background noise and does not weaken the confirmed compromise. Contain the account, reset credentials, revoke sessions/MFA, remove forwarding rule, and assess SIS data exposure.
